correctness.rationale: PASS. Rank-3 equivalence of monochromatic chains has sharp length cap 7; concatenation of EF-equivalent colored orders preserves rank-3 equivalence, reducing every infinite gap triple to 0..7 in all three coordinates. The exact nested-character back-and-forth recurrence is an iff for the 3-round EF game. Independent implementation enumerated each of 512 capped triples and found exactly 310 distinct rank-3 character sets, bijectively matching the proposed zero-pattern canonical triples (no conflicting class). Cardinality 1+3*7+3*6^2+6*5*6=310; unique maximal shortest word 6+1+5+1+6=19. Rank-3 sentences distinguish two vs any other number of red points, so shortest-representative bound holds even against all binary-colored words. All hypotheses (finite, two reds, unary red/blue partition, rank exactly 3) and zero-gap cases checked. This is an exhaustive lemma after a proved finite reduction, not a sample-based infinite argument.
